247: A veteran cop and an unstable detective become partners who must put their differences aside in order to bring down a heroin-smuggling ring run by ex-Special Forces.
If these two can learn to stand each other... the bad guys don't stand a chance.

759: The discovery of a massive river of ectoplasm and a resurgence of spectral activity allows the staff of Ghostbusters to revive the business.
Guess who's coming to save the world again?
1015: A documentary about the closure of General Motors' plant at Flint, Michigan, which resulted in the loss of 30,000 jobs. Details the attempts of filmmaker Michael Moore to get an interview with GM CEO Roger Smith.
The story of a rebel & his mike.

As the rebels move from town to town, their numbers swell as escaped slaves join their ranks. Under the leadership of Spartacus, they make their way to southern Italy, where they will cross the sea and return to their homes.
They trained him to kill for their pleasure ... but they trained him a little too well

In our time, no foreign army has ever occupied American soil. Until now.

The worst of them will stay with you... forever.

What imprisons desires of the heart?

Behind every great martial artist lies a teacher.

Two boys. One can't remember. The other can't forget.

For everyone on the outside looking in... your moment has arrived!
4087: Two detectives observe an escaped convict's ex-girlfriend, but complications set in when one of them falls for her.
It's a tough job but somebody's got to do it!

War has cost them their innocence... Freedom will cost them their blood.

The world is more giant than you can imagine.

What is to give light must endure burning

A rather kinky tale of survival.

Because everyone loves an accurate period piece.
Tristram Shandy / Walter Shandy / Steve Coogan

PRE. The way he competed. The way he lived his life.

One woman dared to keep hope alive.

What's love got to do with it

He's been walking through doors. He's been falling through floors. He's been going through a lot lately, but he's still Dad.

Three people who make life more exciting... love more precious... laughter more joyous!

They never met an adult they couldn't drive crazy.

You can lock your car. But if he wants it...it's GONE IN 60 SECONDS
9207: A hefty homeboy borrows his dad's Mercedes and goes to the beach with his friends for wild sun & fun.

Ready For Fun . . Fight . . or a South Seas Romance . . . ! They find them all on the . . .

One Moment Can Change A Lifetime

10 weddings. 1 summer. No one can survive alone.

They've pledged to be sisters... to the end.

Meet Sam Quint... Stealing from him is the biggest mistake you can make.

One of the Great Adventures of Our Time!
Benjamin Frank Mahoney, President Ryan Airlines Co.
Donald Hall, Chief Engineer Ryan Airlines
O.W. Schultz, Salesman Atlas Suspender Co.

Fantômas / Fandor / Professeur Lefèvre / Marquis de Rostelli
13815: A cinematic odyssey featuring never-before-seen footage exploring David Bowie's creative and musical journey.

In 1946 this man killed five people... Today he still lurks the streets of Texarkana, Arkansas.

The Fate of Mankind Lies in the Heart of One

All Hell Is Going To Break Loose

Love. Hard to find. Easy to fake.

Through the Window He Saw it...but no one would believe him...no one except the Killers!

Before the end of the world, Gage has some people to kill.

A story of friendship or a love story? It's up to you...

FOR FIVE MILLION DOLLARS, HOW FAR WOULD YOU GO?

Mishra ji has very little time to plan cautiously to turn this into a “perfect murder” and leave no trace behind.

You'll always remember your first time

Making history will never be the same again

Let's all live at the mall.

30199: Aymé Pigrenet, a recently widowed farmer, is eager to find a new wife to help him run his farm. Desperate, he seeks the aid of a local matchmaker who suggest that he go to Romania to find a new wife. There he meets Elena.

The hangover will be the easy part.

30967: In lawless badlands, reclusive Cabeleira sets out to discover the fate of his gunman father and grows to be a feared assassin himself.
